evals.prompt: I have one folder per case. Each folder has metrics.csv with columns rpm,tin,tout and pressure.npy with one value per mesh node. Please build a sample_constructor(id_) that returns a PLAID Sample and explain the raw-to-PLAID mapping.
evals.expected_output: Provides an explicit mapping table, a runnable sample_constructor(id_) using Sample APIs, and a one-sample validation snippet with summarize/check_completeness.

evals.prompt: My solver exports nodes.npy, tri_connectivity.npy, and field arrays ux.npy uy.npy p.npy. Convert this to PLAID Sample with clear assumptions for field locations and names.
evals.expected_output: Builds conversion logic for nodes/connectivity/fields into a Sample, states assumptions, and includes checks for required features.

evals.prompt: I only know that each sample is an HDF5 file with groups /scalars and /fields. I need a robust conversion blueprint before coding. Help me map this into PLAID Sample.
evals.expected_output: Asks focused clarifying questions, proposes a structured mapping worksheet with TODOs for unknowns, then drafts constructor skeleton and validation steps.

evals.prompt: I have velocity at nodes but pressure is cell-centered in separate arrays. Can you draft a PLAID sample_constructor without silently remapping locations and call out assumptions?
evals.expected_output: Keeps nodal vs cell-centered semantics explicit, avoids silent remapping, and adds fail-fast checks for shape/location mismatches.

evals.prompt: I already have sample_constructor done. Please write save_to_disk for train/test ids using zarr backend and overwrite safely.
evals.expected_output: Should generally not trigger plaid-sample-converter because this request is storage export pipeline work (writer skill scope).

evals.prompt: How do I load a dataset I already saved and verify roundtrip with Converter.to_dict vs plaid_to_dict?
evals.expected_output: Should generally not trigger plaid-sample-converter because this is post-export readback/roundtrip diagnostics (reader skill scope).

evals.prompt: My source schema is messy: some samples miss /fields/temperature and ids are filenames. Help me design a deterministic sample_constructor with TODO markers for unknown mappings.
evals.expected_output: Triggers sample-converter, asks targeted clarifications, proposes deterministic id handling, and returns explicit TODO-backed mapping plus validation checks.
